text: Fifty gentlemen meeting together, all strangers, are not acquainted with each other's language, ideas, views, designs. They are, therefore, jealous of each other, fearful, timid, skittish.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 24, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 25 September, 1774
